title: A pick that would loosen a shared format is flagged as going against your uniform ruling
why: Your gripe, Oct 27 12:51 CDT (cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh225EHTbUr63KanrkWb8D3Gn): you were offered loosening a shared tool for banchi's record titles, against your standing preference for uniform formats.
note: Ruling, Oct 27 12:51 CDT (shiv), home topic t18 (one home, then variants): a repo that differs from a shared format changes to match; the shared tool never grows a second form. Next cloud lane: skills/waiting-page and the reply-style rule mark any option that widens what a shared tool accepts with "Goes against your uniform ruling (t18)", and the recommended option may not be one; the reply judge flags such a recommendation in a reply. A gate that today lets one repo's variant through (an allow list or an extra accepted form) gets a debt to remove it. Red first on today's case.
